import.setHashFormat: SHA256 of lines sorted by repository-relative path: <file-sha256><two spaces><repository-relative-path><newline>
transformations: Replace the source appId io.ente.locker with the runtime variable ${APP_ID}.
Normalize lifecycle comments to the single-account, one-fixture online lane contract.
Place ordinary online product flows directly under maestro/locker/online and private login under online/subflows to match Auth.
Use the current Locker Open navigation menu semantics label for seeded settings flows.
Open the drawer through one repository-owned compatibility subflow that prefers the current semantic label and falls back to the older published-build header hit target.
Use Search your documents as the seeded-home readiness proof instead of the data-dependent Add item action.
Gate Home Inventory on its final async item count, center the card, and tap its selector-relative content area.
Gate collection navigation in the bulk lifecycle on final async item counts and selector-relative content-area taps.
Open Uncategorized through All collections and accept its growing multi-item count in the shared account lane.
Replace emergency-contact notes through Android Select all and verify the update after a cold app boundary.
Wait for newly deleted items to finish syncing into Trash before asserting the bulk-restore inventory.
Wait for the seeded empty collection's final item count, center its merged semantics row, and tap its selector-relative content area.

hostedUnresolved.create-edit-move-delete-and-restore-secr: Creation and collection-selection semantics still need an isolated green run.
hostedUnresolved.create-edit-move-delete-and-restore-thin: Creation and collection-selection semantics still need an isolated green run.
hostedUnresolved.rename-and-delete-collections: Collection selection/navigation is locally flaky and has not repeated its earlier green result.
hostedUnresolved.rename-and-move-document: Requires an externally prepared document in Insurance Documents; the repository no longer seeds document binaries.
hostedUnresolved.view-collection-and-item-action-menus: The exact published RC exposes no semantic label for the collection popup button, and its coordinate fallback failed on hosted x86_64 after collection entry succeeded.

nativeSystemDeferred.download-document: Requires an externally prepared Locker document and targets the native iOS Files save and replace surface.
nativeSystemDeferred.prevent-duplicate-document-open: Requires an externally prepared Locker document and depends on the system document preview.
nativeSystemDeferred.upload-and-permanently-delete-document: Requires an explicitly prepared native device file; the repository seeds only the empty destination collection.

platformStateDeferred.toggle-document-offline: Requires an externally prepared Locker document plus dedicated platform and offline-state validation.

paidDeferred.manage-collection-public-link: Requires a deliberate paid-product and public-link test environment.
